mechanism_narrative: A FEDFUNDS level above 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy, compressing equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and 20-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 310 signals persistent inflation, triggering aggressive monetary tightening fears and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 310 and 5-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The co-occurrence of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE > 3.5% signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND UNRATE > 3.5 and 60-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market (HOUST > 1300) and robust residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 700000) indicate sustained consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1300 AND RSAFS > 700000 and 20-day forward returns are not positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO above 100 (2017 base) indicates expanding industrial activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 and 5-day forward returns are not positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE above 4.0% signals a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0 and 60-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The co-occurrence of high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0 AND INDPRO < 100 and 20-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 above 22000 billion (2017 dollars) indicates strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 22000 and 60-day forward returns are not positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
